notes.title: Update notifications on Windows and Android
notes.detail: an update button appears when a new build is out; it shows what's new and installs the update in place.

notes.title: Auto summary setting
notes.detail: turn automatic summaries on or off in Settings → AI → General, and create a summary for any document with "Create summary".

notes.title: AI Settings in the AI Playground
notes.detail: choose the language of generated flashcards, or let the app detect it.

notes.title: Runs on older devices
notes.detail: macOS 15, iOS 18, Android 11 and Windows 10 version 1809 (x64) are now supported.

notes.title: Self-contained AI flashcard questions
notes.detail: generated questions no longer depend on the text they came from.

notes.title: Notes and concepts from a video stay separate
notes.detail: they are no longer collected into one master note.

notes.title: Summaries for imported videos
notes.detail: a video is summarized once its transcript has loaded.

notes.title: Web pages imported from a link render correctly
Snip flashcards use your own OpenRouter key when one is set
Concepts from a video or podcast no longer titled "page 0"
No surprise flashcard generation
notes.detail: returning to a video or podcast with the AI Playground open no longer starts generating by itself.
